bodyContourPlacement.evidenceBoundary: Neutral evaluated body contours only. 4 mm radial clearance and height extrapolation are explicit prototype hypotheses; seams, shoulder/neck fit, fabric ease, Large shape keys and motion remain unapproved. The outer right-front panel has 2 mm additional radial offset on exclusive vertices only; shared sewn vertices remain coincident. Layer spacing is an unapproved prototype hypothesis.
bodyContourPlacement.anatomicalOrientation: Avatar front = Blender -Y, back = Blender +Y; GC depth +Z maps to Blender -Y. Front closure must remain on the front.

upperSurfacePlacement.evidenceBoundary: Actual evaluated body points and normals with zero-valued Shape Keys; original garment faces and shared seam vertices preserved. Spatial blend bounds and 4 mm clearance are prototype design hypotheses. Nearest-surface projection does not prove face penetration, strain, Large, deformation or final fit. Maximum displacement fraction 0.9 is explicit bounded relaxation retaining 10 percent of the original geometry. Full projection collapsed triangles on actual input and is rejected; face collapse checks remain unchanged.

shortsOrientationEvidence.method: Signed half-leg to quarter-pelvis nonlinear placement follows the measured Neutral anchors; the four-panel boundary now adds explicit intermediate thigh and crotch-rise contours. Original and revised 2D lengths are retained as hypotheses; no fit acceptance.
shortsOrientationEvidence.evidenceBoundary: Neutral avatar landmark placement and provisional contour geometry only. Gusset, garment ease, penetrations, crouch/sit coverage and Shape Key response remain unmeasured; review the regenerated poses before further decisions.

skirtEnvelopePlacement.evidenceBoundary: Neutral evaluated body horizontal sections; convex envelope encloses both legs where separate loops exist. Increase only radii below measured envelope plus explicit prototype 10 mm clearance; retain larger original flare. No body faces copied, original garment faces/seams retained. Sampled radial clearance does not prove continuous face penetration, cloth, Large or runtime fit.

collarContourPlacement.evidenceBoundary: Neutral measured neck sections start 20 mm above Neck head. Lower bone-head section includes shoulders/arms (circumference 1.4319 m) and is rejected as a collar profile. Start contour 0.1968 m; maximum admissible contour circumference 0.30 m is an explicit prototype guard. Upper heights hold nearest neck contour; original 60 mm collar height reaches above Neck tail and head clearance remains unapproved. No fit or strain acceptance.

necklineTransitionPlacement.evidenceBoundary: 40 mm Euclidean distance to original shared seam vertices is an explicit prototype transition hypothesis. Angular origin uses declared native collar seed center. Original faces and rest lengths unchanged; no strain, head clearance, penetration or fit acceptance.

waistbandContourPlacement.evidenceBoundary: One measured Neutral radial-contour placement for waistband and upper skirt, with common native angular coordinates about Hips. Smooth height blend across declared 60 mm waist transition; lower skirt/hem retains previous measured envelope/flare. 60 mm blend, 25 mm band and 10 mm radial clearance are explicit prototype hypotheses, not fit or rest-strain acceptance. No body faces copied. Large/Shape Keys, continuous clearance and motion remain unapproved.

skirtPleatPlacement.evidenceBoundary: Twelve folds and 12 mm hem depth remain explicit design hypotheses. Native skirt/waistband faces are split together along radial fold extrema before contour placement, preserving sewn waist adjacency. No exact fabric isometry, cloth retention, fit or visual acceptance.
